guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：光學玻璃精密退火
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Precision annealing of optical glass
guides.concept: 以一塊厚 100 mm 的 N-BK7 光學玻璃毛胚為案例：從黏度與 Maxwell 鬆弛時間說明退火點與應變點的意義，推導冷卻速率如何透過假想溫度改變折射率、毛胚內溫差如何依 Adams–Williamson 關係凍結成殘餘應力，再談精密退火爐的均勻性要求、應力雙折射與折射率均勻性的量測，最後設計一份完整的退火程式並以熔次資料表完成與光學設計的交接。
guides.conceptEn: Using a 100 mm thick N-BK7 blank as the case, the course explains the annealing and strain points through viscosity and the Maxwell relaxation time, derives how cooling rate changes refractive index via the fictive temperature and how the temperature difference inside the blank freezes into residual stress by the Adams–Williamson relation, then covers the uniformity demands on a precision annealing furnace, the measurement of stress birefringence and index homogeneity, and finally designs a complete annealing schedule and hands the melt data sheet over to optical design.
procedure: 玻璃沒有熔點，只有黏度隨溫度連續變化的轉變區：退火點定義為黏度 10¹² Pa·s（10¹³ dPa·s）的溫度，應變點為 10¹³·⁵ Pa·s，兩者之間約 30 到 40 K。應力以 Maxwell 模型鬆弛，時間常數 τ = η/G，所以在退火點附近幾十秒就能釋放應力，在應變點以下則需要數小時到數天，實際上被凍結。N-BK7 的轉變溫度約 557 °C，精密退火就是在這段溫度範圍內用受控的速率冷卻。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「黏度溫度曲線與退火點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

穿過轉變區時，結構在某個溫度「凍結」，這個溫度稱為假想溫度 T_f；冷得越快，結構在越高的溫度凍結，密度越低，折射率也越低。每把冷卻速率提高十倍，T_f 大約上升二十幾度，因此折射率與冷卻速率的對數成線性關係，玻璃廠以退火係數描述：n(h) = n(h₀) + m·log₁₀(h/h₀)。型錄折射率對應參考冷卻速率，任何後續的熱成形或模造若用不同速率冷卻，折射率就會偏離，必須重新退火或在設計中用實測值。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「假想溫度與折射率」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

精密退火爐是一個以多區加熱、厚重爐膛與輻射屏蔽把毛胚包起來的慢速溫控系統，目標不是加熱而是讓整個裝載區在冷卻過程中保持極小的空間溫差：橫向溫差會在凍結瞬間變成假想溫度差，直接轉成折射率的不均勻。熱電偶要靠近毛胚、定期以固定點或參考熱電偶校正，控制器以程式化的速率曲線運行數天到數週；毛胚放在耐火板與分離粉上，避免黏結與因接觸造成的局部熱流。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「精密退火爐與溫度均勻性」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

以固定速率冷卻的玻璃板，中心比表面熱，溫差與速率成正比、與厚度平方成正比、與熱擴散率成反比。穿過轉變區時這個溫差被凍結：之後中心比表面多收縮，於是表面受壓、中心受拉，形成永久的殘餘應力；Adams 與 Williamson 在 1920 年給出永久應力與冷卻速率的正比關係，是退火程式設計的核心。厚毛胚因此需要極慢的冷卻，退火時間以週計。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「毛胚厚度與熱擴散率」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

殘餘應力使玻璃成為弱雙折射材料，光程差與應力和光程長度成正比，比例係數是光彈常數 K。量測用偏光儀：Sénarmont 補償法把光程差轉成檢偏鏡的旋轉角，光彈調制器法則以交流訊號達到 0.1 nm 等級；結果以每公分光程的奈米數（nm/cm）表示，是玻璃型錄的分級量。因為毛胚內應力分佈為中心拉、表面壓，量測要在穿透厚度方向與多個位置進行，並以平均與最大值分別記錄。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偏光儀與光彈常數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

折射率以 V 形塊折射儀（精度約 1×10⁻⁵）或光譜測角儀的最小偏向角法（可達數個 10⁻⁶）在多條譜線量測，Abbe 數由 n_d、n_F、n_C 算出；均勻性則用干涉儀量穿透波前：把毛胚磨成平行板後量透射波前，扣除兩個表面的面形貢獻（以油浸或分別量測表面的方法）後，剩餘波前除以厚度就是折射率的空間變化。這些量的不確定度要與公差等級一起寫進熔次資料表，因為設計端會依此決定是否需要重算。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「折射儀與均勻性干涉量測」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

完整的退火程式由四段組成：升溫到退火點附近並保溫足夠時間讓既有應力鬆弛與溫度均勻；以慢速率穿過退火點到應變點的轉變區，這一段決定折射率與永久應力；過了應變點後以較快速率冷卻，此時溫差只造成暫時的彈性應力，不再凍結，但仍須低於玻璃的破裂強度；最後接近室溫時再減速避免熱衝擊。速率切換點與各段速率都由前面的鬆弛時間、Adams–Williamson 應力與折射率公差共同決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「退火程式曲線與速率切換點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

退火完成的毛胚以熔次資料表交付：實測的 n_d、ν_d 與各譜線折射率、折射率與 Abbe 數的公差等級、應力雙折射（nm/cm）、均勻性等級、條紋與氣泡等級，以及退火速率與量測不確定度。光學設計端拿到實測值後進行「熔次重算」：把設計中的型錄折射率換成實測值，重新最佳化曲率、厚度或空氣間隔，再把修正後的加工圖交給光學工廠。沒有這一步，精密退火得到的折射率精度就白費了。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「熔次資料表與設計重算」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Glass has no melting point, only a transition range in which viscosity changes continuously with temperature: the annealing point is defined at a viscosity of 10¹² Pa·s (10¹³ dPa·s), the strain point at 10¹³·⁵ Pa·s, roughly 30 to 40 K lower. Stress relaxes by the Maxwell model with a time constant τ = η/G, so near the annealing point stress releases within tens of seconds, while below the strain point it would take hours to days and is effectively frozen. N-BK7 has a transformation temperature near 557 °C, and precision annealing means cooling through this range at a controlled rate. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Viscosity-temperature curve and annealing point”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

On passing through the transition range the structure freezes at some temperature called the fictive temperature T_f; faster cooling freezes the structure at a higher temperature with lower density and hence lower refractive index. Each tenfold increase in cooling rate raises T_f by roughly twenty-odd kelvin, so refractive index is linear in the logarithm of cooling rate, which glass makers express with an annealing coefficient: n(h) = n(h₀) + m·log₁₀(h/h₀). Catalogue indices correspond to a reference cooling rate, and any later hot forming or molding cooled at a different rate shifts the index, requiring re-annealing or the use of measured values in design. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fictive temperature and refractive index”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A precision annealing furnace is a slow temperature-control system with multi-zone heating, a massive muffle and radiation shields enclosing the blanks; its purpose is not heating but keeping the spatial temperature difference across the load extremely small during cooling, because a lateral difference at the moment of freezing becomes a fictive-temperature difference and hence index inhomogeneity. Thermocouples sit close to the blanks and are calibrated regularly against fixed points or reference thermocouples, the controller runs a programmed rate curve over days to weeks, and blanks rest on refractory plates with parting powder to avoid sticking and local heat flow through contact. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Precision annealing furnace and temperature uniformity”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A glass plate cooled at a constant rate is hotter at its centre than at its surface, with a difference proportional to rate and to thickness squared and inversely proportional to thermal diffusivity. On passing through the transition range this difference is frozen: the centre then contracts more than the surface, leaving the surface in compression and the centre in tension as permanent residual stress; Adams and Williamson in 1920 gave the proportionality between permanent stress and cooling rate that underlies every annealing schedule. Thick blanks therefore need very slow cooling, with annealing times measured in weeks. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Blank thickness and thermal diffusivity”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Residual stress makes glass weakly birefringent, with an optical path difference proportional to stress and path length through the photoelastic constant K. It is measured with a polarimeter: the Sénarmont compensation method converts the path difference into an analyser rotation angle, and photoelastic-modulator methods reach the 0.1 nm level with an AC signal; the result is quoted in nanometres per centimetre of path (nm/cm), the grading quantity in glass catalogues. Because the stress is tensile at the centre and compressive at the surface, measurement is made through the thickness at several positions and reported as both mean and maximum. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Polarimeter and photoelastic constant”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Refractive index is measured on several spectral lines with a V-block refractometer (about 1×10⁻⁵) or by the minimum-deviation method on a spectral goniometer (a few 10⁻⁶), and the Abbe number follows from n_d, n_F and n_C; homogeneity is measured interferometrically on the transmitted wavefront: the blank is worked into a parallel plate, the transmitted wavefront is measured, the contributions of the two surfaces are removed by oil immersion or by separate surface measurements, and the remaining wavefront divided by thickness gives the spatial index variation. The uncertainties of these quantities must appear in the melt data sheet together with the tolerance grades, because the design side decides from them whether a recompute is needed. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Refractometer and homogeneity interferometry”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A complete schedule has four segments: heating to near the annealing point and holding long enough for existing stress to relax and the temperature to equalise; cooling slowly through the transition range from annealing to strain point, the segment that fixes index and permanent stress; cooling faster below the strain point, where the temperature difference causes only transient elastic stress that no longer freezes but must stay below the fracture strength of the glass; and slowing again near room temperature to avoid thermal shock. The switch points and each segment's rate follow jointly from the relaxation times, the Adams–Williamson stress and the index tolerance derived earlier. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Annealing schedule curve and rate switch points”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An annealed blank is delivered with a melt data sheet: measured n_d, ν_d and indices at each spectral line, the tolerance grades for index and Abbe number, stress birefringence in nm/cm, homogeneity grade, striae and bubble classes, plus the annealing rate and measurement uncertainties. The optical designer then performs a melt recompute, replacing catalogue indices in the design with measured values and re-optimising radii, thicknesses or air spaces before releasing corrected fabrication drawings to the optics shop. Without this step the index accuracy won by precision annealing is simply wasted. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Melt data sheet and design recompute”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若把應變點以下的溫度當成仍可鬆弛的區間，程式在那裡放慢冷卻完全無效，而真正需要慢冷的退火點附近卻冷得太快，毛胚帶著殘餘應力出爐，拋光後面形隨材料去除而變化。
量測時以毛胚標稱厚度而非實際厚度換算 nm/cm，或量測點集中在應力為零的中性面附近，報告低估最大應力，鏡片在精磨減薄後因應力重新分佈而彎曲，面形失效。
pitfallsEn: Treating temperatures below the strain point as still relaxing wastes slow cooling there while the region near the annealing point that really needs it is cooled too fast; the blank leaves the furnace with residual stress and its figure changes as material is removed in polishing.

Converting to nm/cm with the nominal instead of the actual thickness, or measuring only near the stress-free neutral plane, understates the maximum stress; the lens then bends when fine grinding thins it and redistributes the stress, and its figure fails.

related.title: 非球面光學加工
related.transfer: 可遷移「玻璃轉變、黏度與應力鬆弛時間」與「殘餘應力雙折射的量測與分級」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；非球面光學加工的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Glass transition, viscosity and stress-relaxation time" and "Measuring and grading residual stress birefringence" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Aspheric-optics manufacturing must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦玻璃轉變區的應力鬆弛、冷卻速率對折射率的影響、殘餘應力雙折射與均勻性驗收；非球面光學加工則以非球面矢高方程、中頻誤差、確定性拋光、鑽石車削與模造、非球面量測與對心公差為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on stress relaxation in the glass-transition range, cooling-rate dependence of refractive index, residual stress birefringence and homogeneity acceptance; Aspheric-optics manufacturing centres on aspheric sag equation, mid-spatial-frequency error, deterministic polishing, diamond turning and molding, asphere metrology and centring tolerances, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「黏度溫度曲線與退火點」與「非球面矢高方程與圓錐常數」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。

以「非球面對心靈敏度與誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Viscosity-temperature curve and annealing point” and “Aspheric sag equation and conic constant”.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 光學玻璃精密退火
history.text: 夫朗和斐在 19 世紀初就發現條紋與應力限制了光學玻璃的品質；1884 年奧托·肖特與阿貝、蔡司在耶拿建立系統化的光學玻璃研發，退火成為固定工序；1920 年 Adams 與 Williamson 以黏彈性理論量化退火中的應力鬆弛與永久應力，1946 年 Tool 提出假想溫度概念解釋折射率與熱歷史的關係；之後 SCHOTT、Ohara 與 HOYA 以電腦控制的精密退火爐與分級制度（折射率公差、均勻性、雙折射等級）支撐微影與天文光學對大口徑毛胚的要求。本課只整理公開的物理與工程方法。
history.textEn: Fraunhofer recognised in the early 19th century that striae and stress limited optical-glass quality; in 1884 Otto Schott with Abbe and Zeiss established systematic optical-glass development in Jena with annealing as a fixed process step; in 1920 Adams and Williamson quantified stress relaxation and permanent stress in annealing with viscoelastic theory, and in 1946 Tool introduced the fictive-temperature concept linking refractive index to thermal history; SCHOTT, Ohara and HOYA later used computer-controlled precision annealing furnaces and grading systems (index tolerance, homogeneity and birefringence grades) to meet the large-blank demands of lithography and astronomical optics. This course compiles only public physics and engineering methods.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「玻璃轉變、黏度與應力鬆弛時間」到「熔次資料、規格等級與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Glass transition, viscosity and stress-relaxation time" through "Melt data, specification grades and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
